name: Accessible Back To Top
description: Adds an accessible 'back to top' button
project_description: Provides a lightweight 'back to top' button as a placeable Drupal block. The button is hidden until the visitor scrolls down past 800px, then reappears fixed in the lower-right of the viewport; clicking it (or pressing Enter/Space when focused) smooth-scrolls the window back to the top. The markup is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0, role=button) and the button ships its own CSS and vanilla-JS behavior with no external dependencies. There is no configuration UI: enable the module, place the 'Back to top block' in a theme region, and optionally restyle it via the '.back-to-top' CSS class.
